mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate stagflationary pressures that compress corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS declines and CPIAUCSL rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In low-rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) triggers policy tightening expectations that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate investment and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO remains below 105.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad economic weakness that reduces revenue growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and INDPRO both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% YoY), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% YoY and RSAFS declines.
